lines.text: Let your quinces be full ripe, then wipe
them, & pare them, & Quarter them, then
take out the cores and seeds, & boil the
Pareings & seeds in Spring water, strain
the Liquor, & weigh your Quinces, with
the same weight of dry C. Sugar, boil
the Quince, in that Liquor, & when
Tender, mash them, & then put your sugʳ.
to the Quinces, & boil it till it Looks
red & smooth, keeping it stirred all
